name: Rollbar
summary: Rollbar is an error monitoring service that catches crashes and bugs in your app, groups them together, and alerts you, with session replay to see what the user did.

free_plan_covers.note: The free plan includes 5,000 error occurrences and 1,000 session replays a month, with unlimited users and 30-day data retention.

first_paid_usd_month.note: The Essentials plan starts at $9/month for 10,000 occurrences a month with 90-day retention, and costs more as occurrences increase.

portability.note: Rollbar uses its own proprietary SDK and API with no native OpenTelemetry support, so switching to another error tracker means re-instrumenting error handling from scratch.

uptime_checks.note: Rollbar doesn't check whether your site is reachable from outside; it only reports errors your app has already caught, so pair it with a separate uptime tool if you need that.

session_replay.note: Session Replay shows what a user did before an error, with built-in PII scrubbing plus block, ignore and mask selectors for sensitive elements.

setup.step: Create a free Rollbar account and a new project to get its client and server access tokens.
Install the SDK with npm install rollbar (add @rollbar/react in a React app).
Add both tokens to your environment file; only the client token is meant to be public.
Create one shared Rollbar config, start Rollbar in server code and in the browser, and hook it into your framework's error handling so uncaught errors get reported.

builder_notes: Keep ROLLBAR_SERVER_TOKEN out of client code; only the client token, with your framework's public prefix, is meant for the browser.
Upload source maps after each build, with a matching code_version, using the CLI or a bundler plugin such as rollbar-sourcemap-webpack-plugin, or stack traces stay minified.
Turn on scrubTelemetryInputs and set maskTextSelector and blockSelector for session replay before recording any page with personal data.
